topics.label: Introduction to cancer evolution and lecture outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's core themes on cancer evolution and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutational selection and epigenetic changes drive clonal fitness and cancer progression.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the contribution of stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin to tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promotional signals, inflammatory pathways, and supportive stroma enable tumor growth and progression.

topics.label: Methodological approaches for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental and computational tools used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of evolutionary, cellular, and microenvironmental factors in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the mutational, cellular, and microenvironmental factors that collectively determine cancer evolutionary trajectories.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of the next session
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides a forward look to the next session on therapies.
